releaseNotes:
1. Balanced Full-Width Inventory Toolbar: Redesigned with dynamic flex expansion across Line 1 (Search stretches full-width to Action buttons, eliminating trailing gaps) and well-balanced Line 2 (Count + Status Pills + Deals Filter on left, Deals Manager + Cashier Photos Toggle on right).
2. Centralized Cashier Photos Control: 'Hide Photos in Billing Screen' toggle in Admin Hub controls the cashier register screen (uncluttered, fast SKU/text mode for cashiers), while keeping catalog images visible in Admin Hub.
